note: The two sets are essentially identical: both cover the same nine drivetrain properties with correct values, units, and quotes, and both keep the free-free-mode damping condition and the FAST/ADAMS no-friction-loss condition. The only difference is how the fully-deployed brake torque is phrased (A as attribute 'fully-deployed torque', B as attribute 'Torque' with condition 'Fully-Deployed'), which is a wash. Both sets state every fact twice (once bound to the component, once to the NREL 5-MW turbine), so both suffer equally from duplication. Neither captures the DOWEC comparison figures (0.35 MW loss at 6.25 MW aerodynamic power, 5,025,500 kg•m² low-speed-shaft inertia) or the driveshaft natural-frequency statement.
remarks: Both extractions appear to be the same pipeline output with one claim rephrased; each of the nine table rows is emitted twice (component-level and turbine-level), inflating claim counts without adding information. Facts both sets omit: the DOWEC-derived 0.35 MW loss at ~6.25 MW aerodynamic power, the DOWEC equivalent low-speed-shaft generator inertia of 5,025,500 kg•m², and the statement that the driveshaft natural frequency matches the RECOFF model (no numeric value given on the page).
